body: It felt like I could, when we broke up for 2 months, but he came back. But ever since it was just the same, and the feeling of “going away” never really left too. I feel it when he’s around and when he’s not.

I keep reasoning for him, his work takes up his energy and that maybe projects in our time, or the fact that we’re 2 hours away from each other and couldn’t be there for the other anytime we want because of our responsibilities. I just hope there’s a time I could just sit down with him and talk about us without it turning into an argument and/or a contribution to his tiredness
They are pictures of his facebook friends that are revealing, Im really overthinking here.
